UC-470.en: Rename the folder '{name}' so it has no * or ? in its name, then try again. Clauseo can't protect conversations in a folder with those characters.
UC-470.note: matter.folder_wildcard: a * or ? in a folder name of the matter folder's path keeps Claude's sandbox from naming it on macOS or Linux, so the host didn't start Claude; {name} is the deepest such folder in the matter's folder display (the matter folder's own name or one above it), isolated; English settled by the orchestrator; with no folder to name, the line is UC-472's

UC-472.note: agent.sandbox_unavailable: Claude's sandbox couldn't be set up for another reason (its short temp folder couldn't be made, or Claude Code's own "sandbox required but unavailable"; a name that isn't UTF-8 is matter.name_unreadable since the security review), so the host didn't start Claude; also matter.folder_wildcard's line when the folder with the * or ? is unknown or out of sight; not retryable

U3-err-matter.name_unreadable.en: Claude can't start in any matter while a matter's folder, or Clauseo's data folder, leads to a folder with a name Clauseo can't read. Rename that folder, then try again.
U3-err-matter.name_unreadable.note: a folder Claude's sandbox must deny has a name that isn't UTF-8 (where another matter's folder leads, or the data folder's real path; a stored folder is always UTF-8), so the host refuses Claude in every matter; it names no folder (the stop line can't know it without a snapshot-format change); routed off UC-472 so the restart advice never shows. A launch refusal, not retryable

UC-846.en: The folder for {matter} has been replaced by a shortcut to somewhere else, so Clauseo can no longer keep Claude out of the place it leads to. Check that folder before you open {matter} again.
UC-846.note: UC-846 (a launch notice, warning level): Claude's sandbox left out where another matter's folder leads because it is `/`, a folder above this matter's, or a system folder; the link itself stays denied; told once per matter per thread for the host's run; {matter} is the other matter's display name, isolated; the line says Claude, since only Claude's sandbox follows other matters' links
